#!/bin/bash
# Usage: book <room> <start HHMM> <end HHMM> <title>
# Appends room<TAB>start<TAB>end<TAB>title to $BOOKINGS (default data/bookings.tsv).
file=$BOOKINGS
[ -n "$file" ] || file=data/bookings.tsv
room=$1; start=$2; end=$3; title=$4
if [ -f "$file" ]; then
  conflict=$(awk -F'\t' -v r="$room" -v s="$start" -v e="$end" \
    '$1 == r && (s+0) < ($3+0) && ($2+0) < (e+0) {print $2 "-" $3; exit}' "$file")
  if [ -n "$conflict" ]; then
    echo "conflict: $room $start-$end overlaps $conflict" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi
printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$room" "$start" "$end" "$title" >> "$file"
echo "booked $room $start-$end"

bin/book.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: book <room> <start HHMM> <end HHMM> <title>
# Appends room<TAB>start<TAB>end<TAB>title to $BOOKINGS (default data/bookings.tsv).
file=$BOOKINGS
[ -n "$file" ] || file=data/bookings.tsv
room=$1; start=$2; end=$3; title=$4
if [ -f "$file" ]; then
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r r s e _; do
    [ "$r" = "$room" ] || continue
    if [ $((10#$start)) -lt $((10#$e)) ] && [ $((10#$s)) -lt $((10#$end)) ]; then
      echo "conflict: $room $start-$end overlaps $s-$e" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  done < "$file"
fi
printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$room" "$start" "$end" "$title" >> "$file"
echo "booked $room $start-$end"

# Usage: today <room>
file=$BOOKINGS

README.md.text:
# Meeting rooms
会議室の予約。`bin/book <部屋> <開始> <終了> <件名>` で data/bookings.tsv に追記する（環境変数 BOOKINGS で別のファイルを指せる）。時刻は HHMM。
`bin/today <部屋>` がその部屋の予約を開始時刻順に出す。

bin/book.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: book <room> <start HHMM> <end HHMM> <title>
# Appends room<TAB>start<TAB>end<TAB>title to $BOOKINGS (default data/bookings.tsv).
# Refuses (exit 1, nothing written) if it overlaps an existing booking in the same room.
file=$BOOKINGS
[ -n "$file" ] || file=data/bookings.tsv
room=$1; start=$2; end=$3; title=$4
if [ -f "$file" ]; then
  conflict=$(awk -F'\t' -v r="$room" -v s="$start" -v e="$end" \
    '$1 == r && (s+0) < ($3+0) && ($2+0) < (e+0) { print; exit }' "$file")
  if [ -n "$conflict" ]; then
    echo "error: $room $start-$end overlaps an existing booking: $conflict" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi
printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$room" "$start" "$end" "$title" >> "$file"
echo "booked $room $start-$end"

bin/today.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: today <room>
file=$BOOKINGS
[ -n "$file" ] || file=data/bookings.tsv
awk -F'\t' -v r="$1" '$1 == r' "$file" | sort -t "$(printf '\t')" -k2,2
